title: GetDictionary
author: JG
description: add read/write dict access for new structures SC.renderer and exudyn.config
releaseNotes: SC.renderer.GetDictionary() and SetDictionary() give and set the materials, the static graphics of the scopes and the render states of the enabled views; exudyn.config has GetDictionary and SetDictionary as well; GraphicsMaterialList.GetDict works again.
